observations.behavior: Replaces inline payload construction with an API call using a generated client, and switches the request payload to send only an ID and a narrow date window instead of the full trace/event.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the frontend to request a summary without embedding potentially large trace or event payloads, relying on the backend to fetch the entity by ID and return the summary. This could reduce request size and avoid payload-dependent failures.

observations.behavior: Adds a typed response interface and a typed request payload, replacing the previous loose typing and inline payload construction.
